title: Loyalty Tenure Multiplier Schedule — Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewal Credits
content:
**Schedule.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit, the loyalty tenure multiplier depends on the calendar days from the service start date to the renewal's plan change date: 2.0 when they are 1095 or more, 1.5 when they are at least 730 but fewer than 1095, and 1 — the plan amount unchanged — when they are fewer than 730, as they are for a customer renewing for the first time out of a twelve-month term. The tenure-adjusted plan amount is the plan amount times that multiplier, and it takes the place of the plan amount in the renewal loyalty credit owed.

The records read are the service start date and the plan change date on the agreement; the plan amount is the renewal loyalty credit amount of the plan in force.

| Calendar days from the service start date to the renewal's plan change date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 1095 or more | 2.0 |
| 730 to 1094 | 1.5 |
| fewer than 730 | 1 |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plan amount 40.00)

| Days | Tenure-adjusted plan amount |
|---|---|
| 1095 | 40.00 multiplied by 2.0 is 80.00 |
| 1094 | 40.00 multiplied by 1.5 is 60.00 |
| 730 | 60.00 |
| 729 | 40.00 |

A customer whose service started 1 October 2024 on a twelve-month term and who renews with a plan change date of 1 October 2025 has 365 days, so the multiplier is 1.
